thread:
Ivy: hi @people-ops — quick situation. i'm the primary caregiver for my dad and need to add him to my medical/dental as a dependent starting 09/01. he lives with me and is on partial social security but not full medicare yet. what docs do you need and will having SS benefits complicate enrollment?

Sam: hey Ivy  sorry you're juggling this. two big things: 1) documentation: carriers typically need proof of relationship/residency + identity. since he's an adult we generally accept a notarized guardianship or durable power of attorney plus a current utility bill showing same address, photo ID, and birth cert if available. 2) Medicare: if he's not enrolled in Medicare Part A/B it's straightforward. if he later enrolls in Medicare we need to coordinate primary vs secondary coverage. Does he currently have any other employer-sponsored coverage?

Ivy: he doesn't have employer coverage. he's on SSI but hasn't enrolled in Medicare parts A/B yet (we're assessing eligibility). i can provide a notarized POA, his state ID, and a letter from his social worker. also want to be sure about tax dependent status  do i need to claim him on taxes to add him?

Sam: tax dependency isn't strictly required for carrier enrollment; plan eligibility for an adult dependent varies by plan language. For our plan adults can be added if they meet dependent criteria (incapacity or lived with employee) and docs prove it. HR will verify carrier terms. Tax status is separate and would affect your withholdings/tax filing, not the immediate enrollment. If you plan to claim him we recommend checking with payroll/tax advisor.

Marta: payroll note  adding an adult dependent will change premiums starting the effective date. if we set 09/01 as the start and you submit docs in time, premiums will be prorated for September on the next payroll. If you want to avoid a single large deduction, payroll can split any retro or prorated amount across two cycles if you request before cutoff. reply here with "split-2" to request that.

Ivy: thanks. also does adding him impact my HSA or FSA eligibility? i'm on HSA-high deductible plan and use HSA pre-tax.

Sam: good question. If adding an adult dependent changes your coverage tier to family, HSA eligibility depends on whether the plan remains HSA-qualified. If the plan is the same HDHP but family tier, you usually remain HSA-eligible (but contribution limits change). For FSA: you can add/decrease elections on a QLE; dependent care FSA typically requires a qualifying dependent under plan rules, so adult dependents usually don't qualify. We'll confirm the exact impact and list the contribution limits.

benefits-bot: Automated: Upload docs via the People Ops secure portal (link pinned in #people-ops). Suggested filenames: `dependent_docs/<lastname>_adult_guardianship_<yyyymmdd>.pdf` and `dependent_docs/<lastname>_utility_id_<yyyymmdd>.pdf`. Reply "uploaded" after adding files. If you need a payment plan for premiums include "split-2" in your upload notes.

Ivy: uploaded files: `dependent_docs/Nguyen_adult_poa_20240810.pdf`, `dependent_docs/Nguyen_dad_stateid_20240810.pdf`, `dependent_docs/Nguyen_utility_20240810.pdf`. i added a note that he'd had SSI and that Medicare enrollment is pending.

Sam: seeing uploads. please post his full legal name + DOB here so we can prefill the carrier form and start a QLE. we'll request effective date 2024-09-01 pending carrier verification. also note: carriers may require an attestation for incapacity; please include any physician letter if applicable.

Ivy: his name is Phan L. Nguyen, DOB 1958-02-12. i don't have a physician letter yet  can benefits start the process and i'll provide the letter if requested?

Sam: yes we can start provisionally with current docs. if the carrier requests additional medical attestation we'll follow up. we'll also flag Medicare coordination in the carrier notes so when/if he enrolls in Medicare we handle primary/secondary correctly. Expect benefits confirmation within 2 business days.

Marta: noted on payroll. Ivy  do you want the prorated September premiums split across two paychecks? if so reply here with "split-2" before tomorrow payroll cutoff.

Ivy: split-2

payroll-bot: Automated: "split-2" noted. Payroll will divide the prorated/retro premium adjustment across the next two pay cycles. If we need additional authorization we'll DM you.

Sam: thanks @Ivy. We've filed the QLE and requested 2024-09-01 effective date. Benefits will confirm carrier acceptance within 2 business days or ask for any outstanding docs (e.g., physician attestation or proof of incapacity). Payroll will apply split-2 for the September adjustment. closing loop once carrier confirms. :white_check_mark:
